selection_rule: User intent selects a lane; lane state never changes the global operating contract.

lanes.purpose: Completed Multiversal Sound & Audio Studio (MSAS) program history. Readable for provenance/integration evidence; no persistent implementation slot or new MSAS execution authority.
source_bundle: live lane execution state from ops3-lane-state/msas
AAI/PCA/DWC and other owner contracts named by the selected MSAS item
live application repository evidence limited to active MSAS scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: MSAS is terminal completed history. Read GPR/MRCS/OARC only for explicit integration evidence; do not start new MSAS implementation without a new owner-governed program.

lanes.purpose: Gameplay Pattern Runtime & Loop Minis (GPR): reusable gameplay-pattern execution/composition over frozen MAL, accepted MRCS definitions and canonical owner-domain contracts.
source_bundle: live lane execution state from ops3-lane-state/gpr
MAL/MRCS and owner-domain contracts named by the selected GPR item
live application/repository evidence limited to active GPR scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Consume completed MRCS definitions and explicit owner contracts as dependencies. Later MRCS domains may late-bind without pausing either lane; GPR-16 may not close before MRCS-21 and relevant specialist golden proofs. OARC remains independent except for explicit dependencies/publication conflicts.

lanes.purpose: Multiversal Rules & Content Studio (MRCS): creator-facing governed reusable rule/content definition authoring over Content Forge and owner-domain contracts.
source_bundle: live lane execution state from ops3-lane-state/mrcs
only owner-domain/PDCP/CAB/Content Forge sources named by the selected MRCS item
live application repository evidence limited to active MRCS scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Read MSAS/OARC only for explicit dependencies or publication conflicts. MRCS execution never pauses, replaces or rewrites MSAS or OARC.

lanes.purpose: Operational Asset Readiness Closure (OARC): game-readiness integration and certification for vehicles, mecha, spacecraft/starships, bases/platforms and their modular content without duplicating MRCS, MIB-14/D17, MERA or MBES authority.
intent_examples: make vehicles mecha ships and bases game ready
continue vehicle mecha ship base closure
source_bundle: live lane execution state from ops3-lane-state/oarc
MRCS-13, MIB-14/PPIA-04/F014/D17 and other owner contracts named by the selected OARC item
MERA and MBES planning contracts only where required to preserve future-owner boundaries
live application repository evidence limited to active OARC scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Consume MRCS definitions and existing owner contracts as explicit dependencies. Read MERA/MBES planning only to preserve reserved authority. OARC execution never pauses, replaces or rewrites MSAS or MRCS.

lanes.purpose: Governance architecture, repositories, CI, agent behavior, execution infrastructure, validation infrastructure and operational tooling.
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Implementation state may be read only to preserve or reconcile it; operations work may not silently start implementation work.

lanes.purpose: Game-system evaluation, world/game content design, mechanics design and content creation that does not itself authorize software implementation.
source_bundle: canonical source material needed for the requested domain
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Do not load implementation-roadmap control state unless the user asks to integrate the result into implementation.

lanes.purpose: The DWC speech-synthesis project and its corpus/training/inference workflow.
source_bundle: the current DWC checkpoint/evidence named there
live DWC artifacts supplied by the user
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Keep DWC isolated from implementation lanes unless an explicit integration task requires both.

lanes.purpose: External research, tools/resources evaluation, vendor/open-source comparisons and technical investigation that does not itself mutate product state.
source_bundle: project constraints only when they affect the evaluation
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Research findings become implementation or operations work only through an explicit follow-on task.

lanes.purpose: Source ingestion, provenance, corpus coverage, licensing traceability and recovery of project source material.
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Source evidence may inform other lanes but does not select their work.

retired_lane_aliases.product-development: Retired umbrella. Resolve explicit intent to msas, mrcs or oarc; this alias cannot select work.
retired_lane_aliases.ui-implementation: UISR-11 completed_verified. UISR is completed program history, not a persistent implementation lane.
retired_lane_aliases.player-species: Completed MVPS program history. Player-species work no longer occupies a persistent lane; new species work requires an explicitly selected governed work item.
retired_lane_aliases.mvps: Completed terminal MVPS lane/program history. It was replaced as the third persistent implementation slot by OARC on 2026-09-20.

parallel_persistence_rule: GPR, MRCS and OARC are independent persistent implementation lanes with separate milestone-only lane-state refs. Terminal MSAS remains completed history outside the persistent slots. Ordinary lane state records only start, complete exact-head prequeue GREEN, durable application publication and one post-closeout successor reseed. Intermediate repository/PR/CI/READY mechanics are not journaled. Shared-repository publication remains FIFO among immutable green READY candidates only.
